content.comment_body: Good morning everyone, Hope you all had a nice break. I'm planning to modify an existing control program to help manage a pump set, with the following objectives: 1. Add temperature-based control 2. Add a time delay I’m a bit unsure how to proceed. The current program works well, but my goal is for the system to start a timer (counting down from 5 minutes) whenever an input triggers the pump set. After the countdown, if the measured temperature is below 50°C, an additional pump should activate and continue running until the temperature climbs above 55°C, then stop operation until needed, returning to the timer cycle. I’m considering a PT100 sensor for temperature measurement. The 5-minute initial delay is intended to give the first pump time to function, using any stored heat first, to prevent short cycling. Thank you in advance for any advice or suggestions. I’ve attached the original program for reference. Wishing everyone a Happy New Year! Update: I have developed the program and initial results seem satisfactory, but I’ll only be certain after uploading and testing benchside. If anyone could review it for correct logic, particularly regarding the temperature block, I’d appreciate it. Also, I believe the PT100 sensor needs to connect to the [product_name] [version_no] analog expansion module supporting 0/4-20mA and 0-10V analog outputs, which appears to be suitable for PT100 integration. Confirmation on this point would be greatly appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user aims to add time-delay and temperature-dependent control functionalities to a pump set by updating an existing automation program. A primary concern is correctly incorporating a PT100 sensor with an analog expansion module, and verifying whether the programmed logic meets functional requirements before live deployment. User confidence in analog input setup and overall control logic is a key user experience issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward guidance on connecting and configuring a PT100 temperature sensor using the automation system's analog expansion module, and seeks confirmation that their developed logic for time-delay and temperature control is technically correct.
